subject: Backyard gathering
text: Hi, I am inviting you to a small backyard gathering on Saturday. It is casual, so just bring yourself. I planned it for six, but the food delivery moved to five. That change means setup may take less time, and I would like people to arrive around four thirty. If that time no longer works for you, tell me today. I need to give a final head count before the store closes. If you can come, great. If not, I understand, and we can do something next week instead. We will keep it short with simple snacks and drinks. That is all, please.
